# Grocery List

## Produce
- garlic (2 cloves)
- lime (1)
- bean sprouts (2 cups)
- green onions (4)

## Pantry
- rice noodles (250 g)
- fish sauce
- tamarind paste
- peanuts (1/2 cup)

## Protein
- chicken thighs (300 g)
- eggs (2)

## Meals
- [Chicken Pad Thai](https://www.recipetineats.com/chicken-pad-thai/) (30 min)
